meta.note: The source styles use literal hex values, not CSS custom properties (the only declared property in the repo is --face-size). Token names here are the roles those exact values play; every value is copied verbatim from the files listed above.

tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: The application background, set on `body` by every page. Grounds `ink`, `ink-secondary`, `ink-muted`, `ink-soft`, `accent-text`.

tokens.name: canvas-deep
tokens.usage: The full-photo review pane on Crowd Review, darker than `canvas` so a photo carries its own edge.

tokens.name: media-well
tokens.usage: Behind a thumbnail or face crop while its image loads, so a slow tile is a dark hole rather than a flash of pane.

tokens.name: pane
tokens.usage: Scrolling content panes: the photo grid, the detail pane, the people list. One step up from `canvas`.

tokens.name: rail
tokens.usage: The status bar and the timeline histogram strip — furniture that sits below the content, not above it.

tokens.name: form-bar
tokens.usage: The Search page filter form, a band of controls above the results.

tokens.name: bar
tokens.usage: Top and bottom bars on the touch pages (Quick Tag, Quick Geocode), and the section panels on People Manager.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Dashboard and settings cards. Grounds `ink`, `accent-text`, `success`, `danger-text`.

tokens.name: chrome
tokens.usage: Toolbars, sticky grid headers, the camera legend, and grouped control panels. Grounds `ink` and `ink-muted`.

tokens.name: chrome-alt
tokens.usage: Toolbar and status bar on the map-first pages (Places DB, Contexts, Representatives), which run one step lighter than `chrome`.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Anything floating over the page: modals, the quick-action popup, the person picker, typeahead lists. Grounds `ink-strong` and `on-accent`.

tokens.name: field
tokens.usage: The fill of text inputs, selects, and the imprecise-drop control group. Grounds `ink-strong`.

tokens.name: control
tokens.usage: Default button fill, count badges, `kbd` keys, and the toast background. Grounds `ink`.

tokens.name: control-hover
tokens.usage: Button fill on hover, and the grey 'no faces detected' segment of the coverage bar.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: The 1px rule under every toolbar and above every status bar, and between panes.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: The lighter 1px rule between rows of a metadata table and under a month divider.

tokens.name: field-border
tokens.usage: Border on inputs, selects, popovers and map controls. Carries meaning, so it holds 3:1 against `canvas` and `field`.

tokens.name: control-border
tokens.usage: Border on default buttons and on the `kbd` key caps.

tokens.name: panel-border
tokens.usage: Border on grouped inline panels — the guess bar, the face assign bar, picker rows.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body copy. Reads on `canvas`, `pane`, `card`, `chrome`, `control` and `overlay`.

tokens.name: ink-strong
tokens.usage: Text inside inputs and selects, modal headings, and emphasised values. Reads on `field`, `overlay`, `control` and `canvas`.

tokens.name: ink-page
tokens.usage: Body copy on the map-first pages (Places DB, Contexts, Representatives), which set their own slightly brighter body colour. Reads on `canvas` and `chrome-alt`.

tokens.name: ink-secondary
tokens.usage: Supporting copy: stat lines, legend labels, basemap buttons. Reads on `canvas`, `card` and `chrome`.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: De-emphasised copy: guess summaries, progress labels, close buttons. Reads on `canvas`, `card`, `chrome` and `overlay`.

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: Field labels, status-bar text on the map pages, settings help. Reads on `canvas`, `card` and `chrome-alt`.

tokens.name: ink-dim
tokens.usage: Metadata keys, counts and month dividers. Reads on `canvas` and `card` at about 4.9:1 — keep it to 11px+ labels, not running copy.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Histogram axis labels and birth-date annotations. Below 4.5:1 on `canvas` (about 3.9:1): decoration and non-essential annotation only, never the only carrier of a fact.

tokens.name: ink-ghost
tokens.usage: Empty-state hints and the resting colour of a table delete button. About 3:1 on `canvas` — use at 12px+ and pair with a hover state that brightens it.

tokens.name: ink-placeholder
tokens.usage: The detail-pane placeholder and the day divider. About 2.3:1 on `canvas` — purely decorative; never put a fact here.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The product's one accent: focus ring on inputs, border of an active button, selected thumbnail ring, drop target outline. 4.6:1 on `canvas`, so it clears the 3:1 floor for a meaningful mark.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Accent text: card headings, year dividers, links, the label of an active button. 8.3:1 on `canvas` and `card`.

tokens.name: accent-fill
tokens.usage: Fill of an active or primary button, a selected list row, and a person chip. Grounds `on-accent`.

tokens.name: accent-fill-deep
tokens.usage: Primary button hover, and the count badge inside an already-active person row.

tokens.name: accent-fill-strong
tokens.usage: The selected segment of a mode toggle, where the label is plain white rather than `accent-text`.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `accent-fill` — 7:1. Use this, not `accent-text`, whenever the type is under 14px on a filled accent.

tokens.name: on-accent-bright
tokens.usage: Text on the 'create a new person' row of a picker, the one accent row that must outrank the others.

tokens.name: accent-quiet
tokens.usage: The label of a face-group header. 7:1 on `accent-header`.

tokens.name: accent-header
tokens.usage: Fill of the default face-group header — the band that titles a day, event or cluster of faces.

tokens.name: accent-header-border
tokens.usage: The rule under a face-group header and under a year divider.

tokens.name: accent-card
tokens.usage: Fill of a cluster, suggested-group or representative-group card — a blue-cast surface that sets a proposal apart from settled content.

tokens.name: accent-card-border
tokens.usage: Border of a cluster or suggested-group card, and the rule between its header and its faces.

tokens.name: accent-card-deep
tokens.usage: The face strip inside a suggested group, one step darker than `accent-card`.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Green for 'done': geotagged counts, the fully-labeled coverage segment, the saved flash. 6.3:1 on `card`. Always paired with a word ('geotagged', 'Saved'), never hue alone.

tokens.name: success-quiet
tokens.usage: The label of a green face-group header and of an assigned-name chip. 7.4:1 on `success-surface`.

tokens.name: success-surface
tokens.usage: Fill of the green face-group header — the 'already labeled' section.

tokens.name: success-border
tokens.usage: The rule under a green group header and the border of a labeled face card.

tokens.name: success-chip
tokens.usage: Fill of the name chip under a labeled face on Crowd Review.

tokens.name: success-action
tokens.usage: Fill of the primary confirm button on the touch pages ('Tag', 'Apply'). Grounds `on-success-action`.

tokens.name: success-action-border
tokens.usage: Border of the primary confirm button on the touch pages.

tokens.name: on-success-action
tokens.usage: Label on `success-action`.

tokens.name: place
tokens.usage: A resolved place name from the offline geocoder, and the meta line of a Quick Geocode group. Reads on `canvas`.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Amber for 'partly done': the partially-labeled coverage segment.

tokens.name: warn-text
tokens.usage: The 'new person' state of the Quick Tag hint, and the label above ambiguous alternatives. Reads on `canvas` and `bar`.

tokens.name: warn-quiet
tokens.usage: The label of an amber face-group header and of a 'come back to this' chip. 8.2:1 on `warn-surface`.

tokens.name: warn-surface
tokens.usage: Fill of the amber face-group header — the crowd and come-back queues, a deliberate 'not yet'.

tokens.name: warn-border
tokens.usage: The rule under an amber group header and the border of a crowd card.

tokens.name: warn-ring
tokens.usage: The 2px inset ring on an ambiguous face — a face the matcher could not choose between two people. 3:1 against `pane`, so it stands as a meaningful mark.

tokens.name: warn-fill
tokens.usage: Fill of an 'or is it this person instead?' alternative button. Grounds `on-warn-fill`.

tokens.name: warn-fill-border
tokens.usage: Border of an alternative-suggestion button.

tokens.name: on-warn-fill
tokens.usage: Label on `warn-fill`, and on the amber alternative chip over a face.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Red for 'missing': the not-geotagged count, the none-labeled coverage segment, backfill hints. 3.9:1 on `card` — it misses the 4.5:1 floor at the 11–12px it is used at in the source; kept exact, and always accompanied by its own word ('not geotagged') so the colour is never the only signal.

tokens.name: danger-text
tokens.usage: Error lines and the label of a danger button. 6.8:1 on `card` and `canvas` — prefer this over `danger` for anything a person has to read.

tokens.name: danger-border
tokens.usage: Border of a danger button and of a table row's delete affordance.

tokens.name: danger-surface
tokens.usage: Danger button fill on hover.

tokens.name: danger-action
tokens.usage: Fill of the destructive button on the touch action bar ('Not a face'). Grounds `on-danger-action`.

tokens.name: danger-action-border
tokens.usage: Border of the destructive touch button.

tokens.name: on-danger-action
tokens.usage: Label on `danger-action`.

tokens.name: danger-quiet
tokens.usage: The resting colour of a reject affordance — the '✕' on a suggestion chip that means 'not this person'.

tokens.name: danger-hot
tokens.usage: A reject affordance on hover, brightening `danger-quiet` so the target is unmistakable before the click.

tokens.name: toast-error
tokens.usage: Fill of a toast reporting a failure, replacing `control`. Grounds `ink-strong`.

tokens.name: marker
tokens.usage: The place dot on the Places DB map, and the glow on a photo whose clock was shifted.

tokens.name: badge-gold
tokens.usage: The border and badge on the representative face — the one crop kept out of a run of near-duplicates. Its badge sets `canvas` as the text colour.

tokens.name: highlight
tokens.usage: The cross-highlight tying a face card to its bounding box on the photo. Transient and paired with a border-width change, so it never carries state on its own.

tokens.name: context-accent
tokens.usage: The Contexts page's own green: the add and save buttons, and the border of a selected context. That page predates the blue accent and is the one screen that does not use `accent`.

tokens.name: context-accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for the Contexts add and save buttons.

tokens.name: context-selected
tokens.usage: Fill of the selected context row.

tokens.name: tint-blue
tokens.usage: First of six group tints cycled across adjacent day/event sections so neighbouring groups read apart without a hard border.

tokens.name: tint-rust
tokens.usage: Second group tint.

tokens.name: tint-green
tokens.usage: Third group tint.

tokens.name: tint-amber
tokens.usage: Fourth group tint.

tokens.name: tint-violet
tokens.usage: Fifth group tint.

tokens.name: tint-teal
tokens.usage: Sixth group tint.

tokens.name: tint-border
tokens.usage: The border around a tinted group section — barely there, enough to close the shape.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind the shortcuts help and the person picker.

tokens.name: scrim-heavy
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind the month-picker modal.

tokens.name: scrim-photo
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind the full-photo overlay, where nothing should compete with the image.

tokens.name: caption-scrim
tokens.usage: The band behind a filename or name caption laid over a thumbnail. Grounds `ink-strong` over arbitrary photo content.

styles.name: display-number
styles.usage: The one big number on a dashboard card — the library total.

styles.name: heading-modal
styles.usage: The title of a modal dialog.

styles.name: heading-card
styles.usage: A dashboard or settings card heading, set in `accent-text`.

styles.name: heading-section
styles.usage: A section label inside a panel.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: The base size of every desktop pane. Set in `ink` on `canvas` or `pane`.

styles.name: body-page
styles.usage: Body copy on the map-first pages, which run one step larger. Set in `ink-page`.

styles.name: control
styles.usage: Buttons, table cells, inputs and selects — most interactive text in the app.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: A setting's name, a month name, a checkbox label.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Counts, hints, help text, legend entries, status bars.

styles.name: micro
styles.usage: Captions and chips laid over a thumbnail. Needs `caption-scrim` behind it.

styles.name: nano
styles.usage: A match score badge or a name inside a bounding box. Decoration beside the thing it annotates — never the only place a fact appears.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: The uppercase family-group header in the people list. Set in `ink-placeholder` in the source; raise it to `ink-dim` if the grouping has to be read.

styles.name: touch-title
styles.usage: The name being proposed on Quick Tag — the one thing a thumb is answering about.

styles.name: touch-body
styles.usage: Picker rows and the picker search field. 16px keeps iOS from zooming on focus.

styles.name: touch-action
styles.usage: The labels on the bottom action bar.

styles.name: touch-meta
styles.usage: Progress counters, toasts and link buttons on the touch pages.

styles.name: touch-caption
styles.usage: Secondary lines under the Quick Tag title: timestamp, place, control labels.

spacing.note: The source has no spacing scale; these are the even step values its stylesheets actually use, named by value.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Chip padding and the offset of a badge pinned into a thumbnail's corner.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: The photo grid gap, and the gap between icon buttons in a toolbar group.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Grid padding, list-row padding, the gap between related controls.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: The default gap — between toolbar items, card rows, and form fields.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Pane padding (detail pane, face review), and toolbar side padding.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Sidebar header padding and the padding of a floating panel.

tokens.name: space-14
tokens.usage: Side padding of the touch bars and the Quick Tag stage.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Card padding and the dashboard grid gap.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Modal padding.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: The gap between top-level sections on People Manager.

tokens.name: radius-2
tokens.usage: A face bounding box drawn over a photo.

tokens.name: radius-3
tokens.usage: Thumbnails, face crops and count badges — the smallest rounding that still reads.

tokens.name: radius-4
tokens.usage: The workhorse: buttons, inputs, selects, list rows, detail images.

tokens.name: radius-5
tokens.usage: Grouped inline panels and the quick-action popup.

tokens.name: radius-6
tokens.usage: Map popups, basemap controls, context and cluster cards.

tokens.name: radius-8
tokens.usage: Dashboard cards, settings groups and centred modals.

tokens.name: radius-10
tokens.usage: Picker rows and the search field on the touch pages.

tokens.name: radius-12
tokens.usage: The big buttons on the touch action bar.

tokens.name: radius-16
tokens.usage: The top corners of a bottom sheet.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Toasts, link buttons and person chips — anything that should read as a lozenge.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: Camera legend dots, map place dots and histogram slider thumbs.

tokens.name: shadow-control
tokens.usage: A control floating over the map, such as the basemap switcher.

tokens.name: shadow-popup
tokens.usage: A Leaflet popup — a map marker's card.

tokens.name: shadow-panel
tokens.usage: The context form panel, anchored to a corner of the map.

tokens.name: shadow-modal
tokens.usage: A centred modal over a scrim.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: The quick-action popup, the person picker and typeahead lists — the layer closest to the pointer.

tokens.name: shadow-thumb
tokens.usage: A histogram range thumb, so a light knob keeps its edge over the bars.

tokens.name: shadow-bbox
tokens.usage: A dark ring outside a face bounding box, keeping the `accent-text` border legible over any photo.

layout.note: Fixed dimensions the app's panes and grids are built from. `face-size` is the only one the source declares as a CSS custom property.

tokens.name: face-size
tokens.usage: The canonical face/photo tile. Declared as `--face-size` in face-grid.css and used as the `minmax()` floor of every auto-fill grid.

tokens.name: pane-people
tokens.usage: The people list column on the People page.

tokens.name: pane-sidebar
tokens.usage: The person picker sidebar on Representatives.

tokens.name: pane-contexts
tokens.usage: The context list sidebar on Contexts.

tokens.name: pane-detail
tokens.usage: The face detail column on the People page.

tokens.name: card-min
tokens.usage: The `minmax()` floor of the dashboard's auto-fit card grid.

tokens.name: measure-settings
tokens.usage: Max width of the settings column — a reading measure, centred.

tokens.name: measure-page
tokens.usage: Max width of the People Manager content column.

tokens.name: bar-status
tokens.usage: Status bar height, matched by its line-height so the text centres without padding.

tokens.name: bar-timeline
tokens.usage: Height of the timeline histogram strip.

tokens.name: opacity-dimmed
tokens.usage: A camera legend entry whose photos are filtered out.

tokens.name: opacity-ignored
tokens.usage: A face marked 'not a face' or ignored, paired with a grayscale filter.

tokens.name: opacity-disabled
tokens.usage: A control that cannot act yet, such as the spatial-focus checkbox before a context is picked.

tokens.name: opacity-geo-ignored
tokens.usage: A photo excluded from geotagging, badged 🚫.

tokens.name: opacity-come-back
tokens.usage: A face deferred to the come-back queue — dimmed less than ignored, because it is a 'not yet', not a dismissal.

zIndex.note: The layers the app actually stacks, lowest to highest.

tokens.name: z-sticky
tokens.usage: A sticky grid header inside a scrolling pane.

tokens.name: z-map-chrome
tokens.usage: The map navigation bar, above Leaflet's own panes.

tokens.name: z-sheet-backdrop
tokens.usage: The backdrop behind a bottom sheet.

tokens.name: z-popup
tokens.usage: Map hints, floating form panels and the quick-action popup.

tokens.name: z-picker
tokens.usage: The person picker, which may open on top of a popup.

tokens.name: z-help
tokens.usage: The keyboard shortcuts overlay.

tokens.name: z-tooltip
tokens.usage: The histogram tooltip, which follows the cursor over everything.

tokens.name: z-modal
tokens.usage: A centred modal and its scrim — the top of the stack.
